short: Audio memory (M02) and multi-head, multi-depth addressing (M06) are standard: the memory is the same group's ICCV design, head and depth gains are single LRW runs, and the LRW SOTA margin is 0.1.
position: The paper [@kim2022distinguishing] recalls audio from a memory (M02), the design of the same group's ICCV memory [@kim2021multimodality], which it uses as its baseline, and addresses it with eight heads at four depths (M06). Both are standard: heads add 0.3 LRW points at one depth and 0.98 at four, depths 1.29 with eight heads, all single runs on LRW. The LRW state-of-the-art claim is a 0.1-point margin over DC-TCN; the LRW-1000 lead over the earlier memory also changes the back end. Today SyncVSR reaches 93.2% on LRW without word boundaries [@ahn2024syncvsr].
